course_title: GRADUATE TEACHING IN ANIMAL AND DAIRY SCIENCES
description: Instructional orientation to teaching at the higher education level in animal and dairy sciences. Direct teaching experience under faculty supervision, including course development, instructional delivery, student assessment, and evaluation. Hands-on engagement via assisting in teaching activities such as syllabus design, lecture preparation, lab and discussion facilitation, exam and quiz creation, and grading. Self-analyze teaching performance, receive constructive feedback, and explore best practices in pedagogy.
